facts.statement: The genus Fortunguavis was described by Wang and colleagues in 2014.
Fortunguavis is classified as an extinct monotypic genus within the enantiornithean theropods.
facts.quote: Fortunguavis is an extinct monotypic genus of enantiornithean theropod

facts.statement: This animal lived during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous epoch.
facts.quote: that lived during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous epoch

facts.statement: Fossils of Fortunguavis date from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The extreme curvature of its foot claws suggests that Fortunguavis was highly specialized for climbing.
facts.quote: The extreme curvature of the pedal unguals of Fortunguavis xiaotaizicus suggests that it was highly specialised for scansorial locomotion
